DDInter1335.mechanism: The use of omacetaxine with other immunosuppressive or myelosuppressive agents may increase the risk of infections. DDInter1435.mechanism: Serious cases of hepatotoxicity, some fatal, have occurred in patients treated with pexidartinib. DDInter150.mechanism: The use of azathioprine with other immunosuppressive or myelosuppressive agents may result in additive hematologic toxicities and increased risk of infections, particularly in transplant patients. Leucopenia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, and rarely, agranulocytosis, pancytopenia, and aplastic anemia have been reported. Treatment with azathioprine alone or in combination with other immunosuppressants, particularly corticosteroids, has been associated with increased susceptibility to infections including severe or atypical infection and reactivation with varicella zoster virus, hepatitis B, cytomegalovirus, and other infectious agents.
